name: agent_redact_key_has_secret_keyword
notes: Secret-keyword word-boundary validator (redact_helpers.c vs LIVE agent/redact.py). KNOWN DIVERGENCE (documented): for ALL-CAPS keys the C port short-circuits to true unconditionally, while LIVE still requires a word-bounded keyword match — so an all-caps prose word like KEYBOARD/PASSAGE returns False in LIVE but True in C. The gate only exercises all-caps inputs where LIVE also matches (API_KEY, MYSQL_PASSWORD); the KEYBOARD-class gap is worth a follow-up port fix.
